quotes.text: The roadmap tab doesn't filter between projects properly, it shows things from both projects

fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (no owner interview) for the bug 'The roadmap tab doesn't filter between projects properly'. Reading the code: internal/web/roadmap.go loadRoadmap and internal/web/change.go dependsOn read /api/roadmap?all=true through the project's ReadOnlyHandler (internal/api/web_api.go). Under a Rhiza root, runRoadmap (internal/api/plan.go) passes all=true to inboxScopes, which widens to every registered project, so /p/<project>/roadmap lists every project's change sets and milestones. health and web_milestones avoid this with the unexported local flag, which an HTTP query cannot set. The planner chose to fix it in the API: a project's web API reads that project's roadmap whatever all says, so every web caller (roadmap page, change set page's depends-on) is scoped, while the CLI's rhiza roadmap --all keeps widening across the root. The fix serves m37-roadmap ('The roadmap shows one project's milestones'). No question was raised.
fields.title: Plan of the bug fix: web roadmap page scoped to its project
